verdict.rationale: While Gram has a public GitHub repo (gram-gh-1, gram-gh-2), the evidence pack contains no documentation, guide, or explicit claim describing self-hosting/on-prem deployment of the Control Plane itself — all docs describe using Speakeasy's hosted platform, CLI, and dashboard. Missing for 10: any self-hosting/on-prem deployment guide, infrastructure requirements, or Docker/Helm installation instructions for running Gram independently of Speakeasy's cloud.
